purpose: Layout 3 design proposals; final implementation awaits the user's selection.
user_constraints: Action buttons stay immediately to the right of the player hand.
Use existing in-game dark card faces and 392:590 proportions.
Match original reference's subdued sea-gray, charcoal fabric and weathered bronze.
Self/opponents retain HP and SAN bars; fixed SAN=6 tick.
Faith effects and tags on left cloth banner; log beneath right turn panel.
preliminary_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE complete polished 16:9 Chinese card-game battle screenshot, landscape, for layout 3 of 《邪神的宝藏》. This is a functional UI layout study, not a fantasy poster. No contact sheet, no explanatory annotations, no external title.

INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative scene, atmosphere, composition and UI material reference. Keep its misty ruined seacoast, distant Cthulhu, dark foreground wooden desk, skull, candles, black hanging fabrics, fine weathered brass frames and limited muted cyan accents. Preserve its restrained detailed painterly-realistic rendering, subdued sea-gray / charcoal / tarnished bronze palette and contrast. Image 2 is ONLY the reference for the FIVE EXISTING GAME CARD FACES: copy these dark faces as closely as possible, including the illustrations, slender fine gold double borders, small card code in header, Chinese name, illustration and DARK charcoal rule area with small cream/gold type. Do not copy image 2's green curved table surface, tentacle/book corner arrangement or layout. DO NOT use image 1's beige parchment card design or large circle cost numbers; the user explicitly rejects those. No bright parchment anywhere, no shiny emerald neon, no excessive added ornamental structures.

COMMON FUNCTIONAL REGIONS:
- Upper left: retain the wide dark framed investigator portrait plaque from image 1. Name "无名调查者". Under name display two full horizontal tracks labeled "HP 8/10" and "SAN 6/10"; muted blood red and slate turquoise. HP fill 80%, SAN fill 60%. SAN has a clearly visible fixed tick at 60% labeled "6", precisely at end of fill.
- Beneath that plaque retain the hanging tapered frayed BLACK CLOTH flag, replacing the poem with current faith and tags. Clear cream text: "当前信仰", "森之领主 · Lv.1", "黑暗子嗣", then small wrapped effect "指定一名角色，在其手牌中加入1张黑山羊幼仔". Three compact tags lower on cloth "邪神遭遇 2" / "虚化 2" / "中毒 1". Natural opaque woven material with finished pointed cloth hem, no gradient fade.
- Top middle: FOUR equal upright reusable rectangular character panels, portraits at top left within each panel, all same dimensions and unsheared. Names "艾伦", "贝拉", "卡洛斯", "黛安娜". Each panel MUST visibly contain two short horizontal HP and SAN bars, a fixed SAN tick labeled 6, AND a little mini-hand strip beneath bars. Example HP/SAN values 7/8, 9/5, 6/7, 8/9. Mini hands show secret cards as dark occult card BACKS, plus one or two public derived cards FACE UP (black goat young or dark slime illustrations). Do not reduce these panels to portraits and single number medallions. Keep enough width for information without covering the huge middle sea view.
- Upper right: retain the turn plaque and circular occult dial of image 1; text "回合 3" and "你的回合". On the dark hanging right region below it replace the decorative quote with a real compact "对局日志": "黑山羊幼仔：失去1 HP、1 SAN", "SAN检定：暂时的平静", "中毒：失去2 HP", "你摸到一张牌", "你回复了1 HP". Ivory small text on CHARCOAL fabric, no beige page. Right information area has a complete fabric hem.
- Bottom: FIVE large actual DARK game card faces from image 2, titles from left "吃下荧光苔藓" / "封入石棺" / "白化生物" / "扭伤" / "秤心仪式". Preserve the source card art, content hierarchy and proportions. Every card is a rigid rectangular image width:height exactly 392:590, mild symmetric fan rotation only, consistent approximately 20% horizontal overlap, same size, no perspective shear. All five cards including rotated lower corners must be fully inside canvas with a little margin; no bottom cropping. Do not invent large new labels below cards. Small universal "手牌 5/4" medallion attached beside left fan base.
- ALL FOUR ACTION BUTTONS must be TO THE RIGHT OF THE CARDS as in image 1, never above or left of the fan. Move them inward to within about one small finger-width of the rightmost card. They must belong to the same foreground desk as the hand, no empty ocean gap separating them. Button labels "掉包", "休息", "繁衍", "结束回合". "繁衍" is a subdued unavailable-state button for this displayed hand. All four use the same reusable long clipped-corner dark brass frame shape as image 1. Distinguish subtly with desaturated teal / muted amber / gray-plum / muted rust interiors; keep low saturation and legible ivory text, no glowing neon.
- Balance the outer bottom corners with EXISTING scene props and a small left card supply cluster "检定 30" / "牌堆 41" / "弃牌 5". Do not fill the central sea view with an invented battle arena, enemy zone, lanes, gameboards or new rules.
- Add a legible contextual hint "你的回合 · 请选择行动", location specified by variant. It should be integrated in a dark modestly sized physical surface, no floating text, no full-screen horizontal divider, no huge rectangular box. Keep upper/lower scene visually continuous.

VARIANT 3A — CLOSE COMPACT RIGHT VERTICAL COLUMN.
Retain the closest composition to image 1: hand occupies the lower center-left, its right edge reaches about 74% of canvas width. Four action buttons in one compact vertical column directly to its right from about 76% to 93% width. Move this column LEFT substantially compared with image 1 to close the gap, and move the fan slightly right. The four buttons together are about as tall as the exposed card fronts, with narrow gaps. The contextual hint is a small fitted dark cloth cap directly ON TOP of the button column, sharing its width and attached metal corners. Log above and buttons below form one clear right spine, but leave a short breathing gap. Keep hint entirely to the right of the fan. No actions across the top of cards. Make this look like an actual usable game screen in the original reference's muted color treatment.

final_prompts.A:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise UI-layout edit.
Make ONE full landscape 16:9 polished game screenshot. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its scene, UI functions, dark game card faces, hanging left faith flag, upper portrait/stats/mini-hand panels, upper-right round/dial and material richness. Image 2 is the original stylistic reference: retain its LOW SATURATION stormy gray-blue sea, black cloth and old bronze, do not become brighter, saturated, glossy or cartoony. Image 3 supplies the existing actual game card faces ONLY, not scene layout. Match its dark bronze-framed card treatment; DO NOT create parchment panels or big round mana numbers. Do not redraw a new visual theme.

Mandatory corrections shared by all versions:
In top 4 other-character panels keep the identical rigid rectangular frames and mini-hands, but make each status pair explicit and correct: 艾伦 "HP 7/10", "SAN 8/10"; 贝拉 "HP 9/10", "SAN 5/10"; 卡洛斯 "HP 6/10", "SAN 7/10"; 黛安娜 "HP 8/10", "SAN 9/10". Fills match their fractions. Each SAN track has a fixed tick at 60% marked small "6", distinct from changing fill endpoints. Self retains "HP 8/10" and "SAN 6/10", same 60% tick.
In opponent mini-hands, face-up cards may ONLY show black-goat-young derived creatures (use the little goat already visible in the first opponent of image 1). Each of first three opponents has three face-down occult cards plus one tiny FACE-UP GOAT. Fourth opponent has four face-down occult cards. Never expose an ordinary secret hand card with the green moss, albino creature, normal card illustration or other ordinary face.
Preserve FIVE bottom hand cards and their established dark faces. Correct their tiny top codes left-to-right to "A3", "B3", "D3", "D4", "D1"; titles left-to-right "吃下荧光苔藓", "封入石棺", "白化生物", "扭伤", "秤心仪式". Keep existing source illustrations and DARK rules areas. Each full rectangle exactly 392:590 width:height. Same size, approximately 20% horizontal overlap, only fan rotation, no distortion, all bottom corners remain inside canvas.
All four action buttons "掉包", "休息", "繁衍", "结束回合" MUST stay to the RIGHT of all hand cards, with narrow comfortable separation from the fan (about 20–35 px at the reference size). Do not put any action above the cards, below the cards, or on their left. Same clipped-corner bronze frame for every button. Subtle dark teal / amber / gray-plum / rust coloration, ivory glyphs/text. 繁衍 dimmed for this sample hand. No neon.
Keep the functional hanging faith panel, HP/SAN self bars, four full opponent panels, round indicator, visible log, supplies and hand count. Do not invent battlefield lanes/zones, extra actions, text labels beneath cards, or a hard upper/lower scene divider. No title, watermark or outside labels.

VERSION A — FINALIZE THE EXISTING COMPOSITION. Keep the lower layout of image 1 unchanged: the four buttons form one close vertical stack on the right of the hand, with a small separately framed contextual hint cap on top saying "你的回合 · 请选择行动". The log is a separate black-cloth panel above; a small breathing gap separates its hem from the hint cap. The card fan is large, immediately adjacent to buttons. Only make the mandatory information corrections; preserve the successful original low saturation atmosphere and all placements.

Each is a long clipped-corner button; use enough width to keep text and icons legible. This block is low and wide instead of a tall column, aligned near the middle/lower half of the exposed cards.
